limitations: Single seed 20262020 and four new epochs per arm; no across-seed uncertainty or broad convergence claim.

Industrial and RF100 are previously viewed external development populations. Feedback48 was chosen after viewing external results. The within-run best_source uses the earliest strict minimum on source1506 among the four new epochs; this is not an untouched confirmatory test.
RF100 uses the existing offline four-point-derived normalized targets rather than an official scalar-reading benchmark. Zero-target/nonzero-target cohorts preserve the full denominator.

Full anchor tensor equality, BN buffer stationarity and GPU execution costs are supported by saved records and inspected implementation. The CPU audit does not load/reconstruct checkpoints or reproduce forwards. Training/validation CNN exposure is inferred from image counts and the one-forward implementation; external CNN counts are instrumented saved records.
The original three-term objective and native RGB-only reader are unchanged. This short BN/statistics/style study does not establish novelty; no arm improves both external domains versus feedback48.
aggregated_training_loss_arithmetic_note: Epoch aggregates of float32 loss terms reconcile within 1e-8; saved prediction and summary metrics use 1e-12. The largest loss arithmetic difference is below 8e-10.
